dct_title_s: Hawaii Wildfires: Damage Proxy Maps, Aug 2023
dct_description_sm: # Hawaii Wildfires: Damage Proxy Maps, Aug 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Hawaii Wildfires (Aug 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Maui, Hawaii, Wildfires, 16 Aug 2023, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Maui, Hawaii, Wildfires, 16 Aug 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Maui, Hawaii, Wildfires, 13 Aug 2023, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Maui, Hawaii, Wildfires, 13 Aug 2023, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023),Validated with FirstLook Imagery Â© 2023 Maxar and Copernicus Sentinel-2
